<div class="review-text">
Incredible game. The environment was very compelling and the controls were fun to get into. Unlike other From Software titles, this one feels like it was very polished and fine-tuned as an experience, taking advantage of putting the players in the shoes of a particular character rather than a general-purpose self-insert protagonist to offer an exceptional linear experience.
